title: [chore][otelcol] Fix flaky TestComponentStatusWatcher on Windows CI
body:
`TestComponentStatusWatcher` is still flaky on Windows CI. The fix in #15982 nested an `assert.Eventually` inside the outer polling closure while holding `mux`. The inner poll captured a fixed status slice that could never change (the held mutex blocked `onStatusChanged` from appending new statuses), so on slow Windows runners it spun for the full timeout and then registered a permanent `assert` failure.

Use `require.EventuallyWithT` instead: the assertions retry until they hold and only report on the final attempt, and the mutex is never held while waiting. Drop the now-unused `reflect` import.

Fixes #15959
